nom: good light Strawberry Moon Grinding Cleansing Balm

concerns.spots: One reviewer reports severe cystic acne breakouts with every use; another separately reports blackheads becoming basically non-existent, so experiences diverge sharply.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer describes painful cystic acne triggered by repeated use, while a different reviewer credits the balm with clearing up blackheads.

aspects.libelle: Product runs out quickly for price
Effective at removing makeup and mascara

extraits.texte: Smells great and neat packaging, but broke me out with painful cystic acne every single time i used it and will be returning.

extraits.titre: Good product, not enough of it
extraits.texte: I was recommended this by an Ulta associate. It works great to remove my makeup and as a cleanser. My face was left feeling very soft. Unfortunately, after less than a month I ran out of product. For the price, I cant justify buying this again.

I went ahead and tried this cleanser. I wear medium to heavy makeup,not everyday probably two to three times a week and the performance was fine. my main ick was the product itself. didn't last as long as I would like and I did have to dip in a second time to completely remove makeup.

I didn't expect anything less from good light. This is the oil cleanse I've been waiting for. The softest and most beautiful cleansing experience that turns into strawberry milk – nourishes without stripping. OBSESSED with this. The fragrance is also pleasant and I love.

extraits.titre: The best cleansing balm I've ever tried
extraits.texte: The package is sanitary, no contamination to the remaining product. Very lightweight and easily emulsifies with water. Rinses off well and leaves ZERO residue. My skin feels so so soft after and my blackheads are basically non-existent. 10/10, highly recommend 🤩

Smells amazing, feels amazing, makes my face look and feel amazing after use! I purchased this on October 11 and just ran out of it today, November 25 after using 2-3 "turns" daily. I use it as the first step in my cleansing routine and then follow with a foaming cleanser. I am hooked!

extraits.titre: I need a hundred of these
extraits.texte: this is phenomenal. I love the packaging design because you dont have to scoop in with ur fingers. it works great, and feels great too. has a nice light scent. feels gentle on the skin.

reserve: Reviews rarely state the reviewer's skin type, so the 'segments' breakdown could not be populated and conclusions are based on very few, mostly brief reviews.
